info.name: Automation Exercise - Search Product API
info.description:
Section 2 API checks for the Senior QA assignment.

Docs: https://automationexercise.com/api_list (API 5: POST To Search Product, API 6: POST To Search Product without search_product parameter).

A1-A3 are the cases the brief requires. A4-A6 are extra cases.

Tests marked 'Docs:' check documented behaviour. Tests marked 'Observed:' record actual behaviour where the docs are silent or ambiguous; they describe the current state and are not a claim that it is correct.

request.description: Brief: a search term with no matching products. The docs do not describe the no-match response.

exec: pm.test('Observed: body responseCode is 200 (docs do not define no-match)', () => pm.expect(body.responseCode).to.eql(200));
